name: Sailor's Warning (3-4)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
description: An illusory cyclops in oracular robes cries out a warning, but then dissolves into a violent phantasmal cyclops, which calls out for the Blind Formless Chaos That Lies Behind the Stars to accept his sacrifice. It then plunges an obsidian athame into a creature's chest, summoning a foul entity.
disable: DC 18 Arcana (trained) to repair Chamenaiti's magic, DC 20 Religion or DC 20 Occultism (trained) to offset the prayer, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract the warning
routine: a Rubbery crimson tentacles appear from a rip in the air and grasp at all creatures in the area, dealing (1d8) Bludgeoning Damage] damage (Basic DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save).
